tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans only H = 0.16–0.48, far below the target H = 23.2. The archived sink-coupled dual-horizon mechanism explicitly requires the slow-horizon probe to identify its adaptation term.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify five parameters reliably or constrain the slow adaptation at the target horizon.
Long-horizon observations more directly discriminate slow adaptation from static sink and memory mechanisms.
The short-window pilot cannot establish whether a slow reversal occurs.
